caption: The drawing depicts a single women's shoe with a light beige or tan color as the primary hue. The shoe has a rounded toe and a slightly pointed front. Decorative beading or embroidery in light purple, blue, and white forms a bow pattern on the top front section. The heel is moderately high and curves inward, with a thick, rounded base. The inner part of the shoe is visible, showing a simple outline indicating the inside edge and the number "35" written faintly along the inner edge. The shoe is rendered against a plain, light background, and at the bottom right corner, there is typed and handwritten text reading "FEDERAL ART PROJECT WPA of VA BY EDNA REX."
title: Wedding Slippers
